messages:
sam: Heads-up — promo stuck on deploybot. Seeing repeated artifact fetch retries from the staging cache layer, 504s and 429s.

kira: link to logs?

sam: https://ci.internal/logs/1799990000 - main error: `GET /artifacts/abcd1234 504` then rapid retries. deploybot shows backoff but keeps hitting the same shard.

leo: I see the pattern — cache node `cache-s-3` returning `EHOSTUNREACH` intermittently, followed by deploy scheduler retry fanout. Amplifies thundering herd.

maya: deploy-bot shows these metrics: `read_retries=312`, `failed_fetch=21`, `avg_fetch_ms=1420` over last 10m.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421 cache-read-thundering-herd; paging oncall.

release-manager: We have a release window at 13:00 UTC. Is this going to block promotion?

sam: Yes. Current policy blocks promotions when >5 failed artifact fetches for the canary job. We're at 21.

kira: Can we pin to last-good image digest and force a manual promote? Risky but faster. Thoughts?

leo: Manual pin only if we guarantee canary smoke passes. But the artifact store is flaky — pinning won't help if fetches still fail on same cache nodes.

maya: Ops suggests routing pulls to fallback registry for this release: `registry-fallback-eu`. That bypasses cache shard. Deploy-bot can attempt fallback on 3rd retry.

sam: Can we change deploybot fallback threshold now? It's currently 5 retries before fallback. Lowering to 2 would reduce load on bad shard.

leo: I can patch deploy-scheduler config and rollout a hotfix to deploybot routing (short-lived). Will need quick approval.

release-manager: Approve hotfix for routing change + manual promote plan if canary smoke green. Keep change window.

maya: Patching now: `kubectl apply -f deploybot/fallback-tuning.yaml` (changed `fallback_after_retries` to 2).

ops-bot: Deploybot config rollout: 3/3 pods updated.

sam: Triggering a new manual canary promote now (pin to digest abcd1234) and forcing fallback usage.

deploy-bot: Promotion attempt started for canary, using fallback registry on retry 2.

maya: Canary smoke tests running...

leo: Observability — failed_fetch dropped from 21 -> 0 in the last 60s, avg_fetch_ms -> 320. Looks good.

release-manager: Canary passed. Manually promoting to stable. Documenting rollback signal: `rollback=true` if we see >10% error increase in next 15m.

sam: Noted. I'll monitor and tag the release notes with the incident and the manual routing hotfix.

kira: Thanks team. Follow-up: schedule deeper root cause for cache-s-3.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0421 updated: workaround applied, postmortem required.

release-manager: Closing promo thread — release moved forward. Add postmortem owner: @leo.
